title: sdks: unify auth/retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity fixes + version bumps (py/ts/go)
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: bring parity and ergonomic defaults across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs for auth, retry behavior, and streaming APIs; also perform minor version bumps to publishable packages. This PR centralizes auth/token-refresh logic, standardizes retry/backoff configuration and headers handling, simplifies streaming client ergonomics (single-stream read APIs + explicit Cancel token), applies parity fixes found during integration tests, and updates package versions for PyPI/npm/go module compatibility. Changes are intentionally small per SDK but coordinated to avoid breaking existing call sites. Checklist: 1) python: unified AuthSession + retries adapter, StreamingClient context-manager ergonomics, tests updated; 2) typescript: auth refresh hook + centralized retry middleware, streaming ReadableStream wrapper with cancel token, minor API alias for parity; 3) go: token source interface unified, retry policy struct exported, streaming Reader convenience helper; 4) integration tests updated across SDKs; 5) bump package versions and CHANGELOG entries. Related: ENG-3241 (SDK parity), ENG-3278 (streaming ergonomics).
